query:
UPDATE
                email_sync_streams
            SET
                notified_at=clock_timestamp(),
                notified_traceparent=$3,
                next_run_at=GREATEST(LEAST(next_run_at,now()),provider_retry_at)
            WHERE
                link_id=$1 AND generation=$2 AND kind IN ('folder_catalog','mail_folder','mail_folder_live')
